image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile app
Primary request: Create one horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the SAME fictional adult East Asian woman in her CURRENT unstyled haircut from four true views: front, exact left profile, exact right profile, and back. This is not a makeover and must not show a proposed result.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm light-gray studio background, identical neutral camera distance and soft daylight in all panels.
Subject: adult woman around 34, natural skin texture, calm neutral expression, softly rectangular-to-oval face, moderate head size, medium neck length, gently sloping shoulders, wearing the exact same simple muted blue-gray crew-neck top in every panel. Current hair is dark natural brown, a grown-out shoulder-grazing lob with a near-center natural part; crown lies relatively quiet/flat; face-framing pieces start below the cheekbone; visible weight collects from lower cheek through upper neck; ends brush the shoulders and show small irregular inward and outward bends rather than styled waves; the back has moderate fullness and a slightly uneven natural fall. Hair should look clean, dry, lightly air-dried, with normal flyaways and no salon blowout.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial salon documentation photograph, honest hair texture, no beauty filter.
Composition/framing: 4 equal vertical panels in one landscape image, full top of head, full hairstyle outline, bottom line, neck and both shoulders. True front/profile/back documentation, matched camera distance and lens perspective. Keep identity, head/face proportions, hair length, clothing and lighting exactly consistent.
Lighting/mood: soft even daylight, analytical and neutral.
Constraints: current pre-service state only; not a reference hairstyle, proposed cut, before/after or chemical result. No labels, arrows, measurements, watermark or text. Do not crop crown, neckline, bottom line or shoulders. Profiles are genuine 90-degree views and back shows no face.
Avoid: split identities, glamour retouching, obvious curls, salon blowout, wet hair, excessive symmetry, three-quarter angles, hands, accessories or extra people.
